metadata.title: The extensible no-four-on-a-circle problem
metadata.abstract: We show that there exists a set $S \subset \mathbb{Z}^2$ containing no four points on a circle or a line such that $|S \cap [n]^2| = \Omega(n)$ as $n \rightarrow \infty$. Since any no-four-on-a-circle set in $[n]^2$ has size $O(n)$, this resolves (up to a constant) a question raised by the current authors and Keevash concerning the density of extensible no-four-on-a-circle constructions. Our construction is based on weighted random sampling from the integer lattice followed by careful deletion.

analysis.workSummary: 构造一个无限整数格点集，任意圆或直线上无四点，且在 [n]² 中有线性数量级点，达到可延展问题的最优阶。
analysis.breakthrough: 兼顾无限可延展性与有限窗口中的渐近最优密度阶。
analysis.limitations: 最优仅指相差常数的阶；并非给出最佳线性常数或每个窗口的精确极值。 数学分析仅依据摘要及评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索和命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 5.4–5.6 Pro 与 Gemini 3.1 Pro 辅助引理2.2的计算和简化，ChatGPT 6 Pro 润色终稿；高层证明思路归于作者。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.20447v1 · PDF第2页，Statement of AI use

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 ChatGPT 5.4–5.6 Pro 与 Gemini 3.1 Pro 辅助引理2.2的计算和简化，ChatGPT 6 Pro 润色终稿；高层证明思路归于作者。

analysis.priorityReason: 离散几何构造有方法价值，但与曲率测度空间重点较远。
